function createEnglishAuction(address _nftContract, uint256 _tokenId, uint256 _startingBid, uint256 _duration) external
function createDutchAuction(address _nftContract, uint256 _tokenId, uint256 _startPrice, uint256 _endPrice, uint256 _duration) external

function getAuction(uint256 _auctionId) external view returns (tuple(uint256 auctionId, uint8 auctionType, uint8 status, address seller, address nftContract, uint256 tokenId, uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime, uint256 startingPrice, uint256 endPrice, address highestBidder, uint256 highestBid))
event AuctionCreated(uint256 indexed auctionId, address indexed seller, address nftContract, uint256 tokenId, uint8 auctionType, uint256 startingPrice, uint256 endTime)
event BidPlaced(uint256 indexed auctionId, address indexed bidder, uint256 amount)
event RefundSent(address indexed bidder, uint256 amount)
event AuctionFinalized(uint256 indexed auctionId, address indexed winner, uint256 amount)
